title: Training for Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.40684v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a simple model of training an agent with an endogenous bias. A principal chooses in which states to train the agent and what actions to prescribe in these states. In response, the agent updates their bias and then acts optimally given their new bias in untrained states, while following their training in trained states. The agent chooses their new bias to minimize a weighted average of their loss under their initial and final biases. Training can thus generalize to untrained states via the agent's bias updating. We characterize optimal training, which involves \emph{over-correction} in trained states and \emph{generalization-aware} (non-greedy) selection of training states. If only a small share of states can be trained, greedy state selection is approximately optimal, but over-correction remains essential. translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个训练具有内生偏差的智能体的简单模型。委托人选择在哪些状态下训练智能体，以及在这些状态下规定其采取何种行动。作为回应，智能体会更新其偏差，然后在未训练状态下根据新偏差最优地行动，而在已训练状态下则遵循训练指令。智能体选择其新偏差，以最小化其在初始偏差和最终偏差下损失的加权平均值。因此，训练可以通过智能体的偏差更新而泛化到未训练的状态。我们刻画了最优训练的特征，其中包括在已训练状态下的“过度矫正”（over-correction），以及对训练状态的“泛化感知”（非贪婪）选择。如果只能训练一小部分状态，贪婪的状态选择是近似最优的，但过度矫正仍然至关重要。如果任何偏差函数都是可能的，或者如果委托人通过对承认这种可能性的偏差函数进行稳健评估来衡量训练效果……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个委托人通过在部分状态下训练具有内生偏差的智能体来实现对齐的模型，证明最优训练需要在已训练状态下进行“过度矫正”，并借助智能体的偏差更新使训练效果泛化到未训练的状态。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model in which a principal trains a biased agent in selected states, showing that optimal training requires over-correction in trained states and can generalize to untrained states through the agent's endogenous bias updating.
